materials.currentTargetPreview: Each capability declares an explicit trust/reconstruction disposition against its P0 semantic inputs and outputs. A source-derived transformation or generated/reconstructed output is bound to the exact source/request version and declared semantic output branch; the source is never overwritten. A derivative may change meaning or fidelity and is not a claim of lossless preservation. Record the transformation or generation method and effective profile/version, provenance, evidence, uncertainty, and material limits; never present generated detail as recovered fact. An estimator, classifier, measurement, quality assessor, or other inference returns an observation with method/model and version, source/version, applicable scope, evidence, uncertainty, and limitations, and must not label an estimate as ground truth. A state/reference-only or non-transforming operation explicitly records that it neither reconstructs content nor establishes inferred facts; it cannot claim a content effect or evidence it did not produce. Owner-state observations, caller plans, policy decision references, versioned definitions, and recorded project changes have distinct epistemic roles: a plan is not an observation or applied effect, a policy reference is not a grant, and readiness is not admission. A returned state is current only when its exact owner, operation, tenant/version scope, and observation-time authority are valid. If the exact output semantics do not establish which branch applies, preserve UNKNOWN and block the affected claim rather than infer from a capability name. This policy does not grant rights, consent, execution, provider admission, scientific validity, or independent acceptance.
